# Affluent Labs

**Open-source software for people who deserve better tools.**

</div>

---

## What we build

Affluent Labs is an independent software studio. We build production-grade,
open-source desktop applications for problem domains historically dominated by
five-figure commercial tools and 1995-era user interfaces.

We ship under permissive licences. We don't gate features behind subscriptions.
We don't collect telemetry. We sign every Windows release through the
[SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org) so the binaries you download are
provably the binaries we built.

## Projects

### [Cinder](https://github.com/AffluentMods/cinder) — digital-forensics toolkit

The cross-platform forensics workstation that consolidates eight or more
single-purpose tools — Autopsy, FTK Imager, the Eric Zimmerman suite,
Volatility, Hindsight, ExifTool, Plaso, WinHex — into one Avalonia-based UI on
.NET&nbsp;10. Apache-2.0.

> *Currently pre-alpha. See the
> [roadmap](https://github.com/AffluentMods/cinder/blob/main/ROADMAP.md) for
> what's shipping when.*

---

## Values

- **Source-available isn't open source.** Every line we ship is on GitHub under
  a license the FSF and OSI both bless.
- **No telemetry.** Our applications do not phone home.
- **Court-defensible by design.** Where our software produces evidence, every
  step is auditable and reproducible.
- **Cross-platform first.** Windows and Linux are equal citizens; macOS is on
  the roadmap.

## Sponsor

If something we build saves you time,
[sponsor on GitHub](https://github.com/sponsors/AffluentMods). Funds go to
code-signing renewals, test hardware, and domain fees — not salaries.
